LAKER
AIRWAYS
Please help us comply with Federal Aviation Regulations
• Review the information on this card.
• Observe all posted signs.
• Pay attention to our crew members' instructions at all times.
Because we care about your safety...
• If you are seated in an exit row, and do not understand
English, please contact a crew member immediately.
Debido a que nos importa su seguridad...
• Si usted está sentado en una fila de salida y no comprende
inglés, por favor comuníquese con un miembro de la
tripulación inmediatamente.
Parce que votre sécurité nous intéresse...
• Si vous êtes assis dans une rangée qui mène à une sortie
et si vous ne comprenez pas l'anglais, veuillez vous mettre
en rapport immediatement avec un membre de l'équipage.
Weil uns Ihre Sicherheit wichtig ist...
• Wenn Sie bei einem Notausgang sitzen und nicht Englisch
sprechen, melden Sie sich bitte sofort bei einem Flugbegleiter.
ATTENTION
Passengers Seated in an Exit Row
Please Review the Following Information
In the event of an emergency and if a crew member is
unavailable, you may be asked to assist other passengers,
provided that you are willing to do so and you:
• Are at least 15 years old.
• Have the mobility, strength, dexterity, and balance to
operate the exit door and slide and to help passengers safely
leave the aircraft.
• Can clearly hear, understand, and communicate oral
instructions.
• Require no visual aids other than glasses or contact lenses.
• Have no physical conditions or responsibilities, such as caring
for another passenger, which could cause harm to yourself or
others if you were to perform this function.
Please alert a crew member immediately if you do not under-
stand this information or need to be reseated for safety reasons.
Thank You For Your Cooperation.
Do Not Remove This Card From Aircraft
